clips.title: The story
paras: Beezil's Wreck marks the crash site of an unfortunate goblin zeppelin deep within the quagmires of Dustwallow Marsh. Resting east of Tabetha's Farm, the shattered vessel's cargo holds scattered supplies and volatile engineering components that attract scavengers.

Hidden away in the humid muck east of Tabetha's Farm lies the splintered skeleton of a goblin zeppelin known as Beezil's Wreck. The craft was hauling cargo southward across Kalimdor before suffering a disastrous plunge into the swamp. While the wreckage still smolders amid tangled reeds, its eccentric captain, Beezil, has seemingly vanished from the marsh, leaving behind scattered crates and ticking machinery to slowly rot in the brine.

Despite the harsh environment, the crash site remains a prime target for opportunistic explorers. The airship carried a payload of volatile goods, notably Seaforium boosters and heavy crates that survived the impact. Scavengers daring enough to wade through the surrounding beasts often risk life and limb to secure what is left of the lost shipment before corrosive marsh water ruins the haul entirely.
